# Showsbee.com

> > Global trade show and exhibition directory connecting businesses with international events, venues, and industry opportunities worldwide.

Showsbee.com serves as a comprehensive database of trade shows, exhibitions, and conventions across industries including manufacturing, construction, electronics, beauty, and agriculture. The platform profiles major exhibition centers like IFEMA Madrid, RICEC Riyadh, and ExpoForum St. Petersburg, while cataloging thousands of events across key markets in China, Saudi Arabia, United States, Germany, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Trade shows and exhibitions
- International convention centers
- Exhibition venues worldwide
- B2B industry events
- RICEC Riyadh
- IFEMA Madrid
- China trade fairs
- Saudi Arabia exhibitions
- Construction and machinery shows
- Electronics manufacturing expos
- Agriculture equipment fairs
- Business services events
- Event directory services
- Global exhibition calendar
